description: Draws a map of a company's software systems and how data moves between them (automatic, manual, export/import), as a Mermaid diagram with a shareable link. Flags manual handoffs, the same data kept in several unsynced systems, hub systems many processes depend on, and systems with no connections. Use after interviewing the user about their systems; nothing is stored.

company.description: Company name, shown on the map.

from.description: Source system name (must match a system name).

hours_per_week.description: Staff hours per week spent on this flow, if manual.

method.description: automatic = integration or sync | manual = someone re-types it | export_import = files exported and uploaded by hand | unknown

to.description: Destination system name (must match a system name).

systems.description: Every software system, database or important spreadsheet the business uses.

category.description: What it is used for, e.g. CRM, accounting, inventory, ERP, e-commerce, support, HR, spreadsheet, custom database.

data.description: Kinds of data stored in it, e.g. customers, orders, invoices, products, employees. Use the same words across systems.

name: build_systems_map
title: Systems Map
